name: Wake (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Wake town emblem in purple: two stylised brush strokes, like the character 和.
history: Municipal flag of Wake, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2006.

features.role: Wake town emblem — two stylised brush strokes, like the character 和
